# `main.aug` specification

August 0.19.0. This document is compiled from checked code with deterministic wording guided by Simplified Technical English.

## In this file

- Register 2 dependency providers before startup.
- Run 5 other startup steps in source order.

## Dependency providers

Register these providers before startup. Their declaration order does not set initialization order; shared instances initialize in dependency order.

- Provide [`SystemConsole`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-SystemConsole) when `Console` is requested. Reuse one instance.
- Provide [`ConsoleLogger`](console.aug.md#symbol-ConsoleLogger) when `Logger` is requested. Reuse one instance.

## Startup, in source order

- Set `greeter` to call [`Greeter`](greeter.aug.md#symbol-Greeter) with `x` = `4`; inject `logger` from `Logger`.
- Call [`Greeter.greet`](greeter.aug.md#symbol-Greeter.greet) on `greeter` with `name` = `"AugScript"`; inject `console` from `Console`.
- Set `count` of type `int` to `7`.
- Set `count` to call [`increment`](math.aug.md#symbol-increment) with `value` = `count`.
- Call `print` with `value` = `count`.
